items.powergrid:circuit_schematic.tooltip.crea: Sneak right-click to convert into an assembled circuit
items.powergrid:electrobaton.tooltip.behaviour: Attacked enemies will be _stunned_ and _no durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
items.powergrid:electrobaton.tooltip.summary: Pushes back and stuns enemies (if they aren't too strong) when powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
items.powergrid:electrozapper.tooltip.behaviou: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
items.powergrid:electrozapper.tooltip.summary: Fires a lightning bolt that bounces off of nearby enemies, splitting the damage between them. Can be powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
items.powergrid:incomplete_circuit.tooltip.sum: Use _Mechanical Arms_ to insert used components and complete the circuit
items.powergrid:integrated_circuit.tooltip.sum: The integrated circuit is back! By deploying a circuit over a _compatible_ piece of equipment, you can _boost_ it, improving its _performance_ for a _limited_ number of uses. Beware, once boosted, the item will consume _twice_ as much power.
items.powergrid:multimeter.tooltip.behaviour1: Can be used to probe voltage between terminals and current flowing through wires
items.powergrid:multimeter.tooltip.summary: A multi-purpose tool, handful to anyone who wants to play with electricity
items.powergrid:pentode.tooltip.behaviour1: The _Screen_ must be positively biased. It shields the anode from the control grid and allows higher gain than a triode.
items.powergrid:pentode.tooltip.summary: A vacuum tube like a triode, with an extra _Screen Grid_ (G2) between the control grid and the anode for higher gain.
items.powergrid:portable_battery.tooltip.behav: Provides _Energy_ to Equipment that requires it
Stores energy at a rate depending on the _Supplied Voltage_
items.powergrid:portable_drill.tooltip.behavio: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
items.powergrid:portable_drill.tooltip.summary: Mines blocks with the strength of a diamond. When powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_, it mines faster the longer you use it.
items.powergrid:portable_saw.tooltip.behaviour: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
Sneak to harvests whole trees at once
items.powergrid:portable_saw.tooltip.summary: A saw for sawing wood. Can be powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
items.powergrid:thyratron.tooltip.behaviour1: Fires when anode voltage exceeds the strike voltage set by the _Grid_. A positive grid pulse can trigger conduction.
items.powergrid:thyratron.tooltip.behaviour2: Stays _latched on_ even if the grid is driven negative. Extinguishes only when anode current drops below holding or reverses.
items.powergrid:thyratron.tooltip.summary: A gas-filled tube that latches on when anode voltage exceeds a grid-controlled strike voltage. Once fired, the grid loses control until anode current drops or reverses.
items.powergrid:triode.tooltip.behaviour1: Conducts from _Anode_ to _Cathode_. A small change in _Grid_ voltage produces a large change in anode current.
items.powergrid:triode.tooltip.summary: A vacuum tube that amplifies signals. Anode current is controlled by a small voltage on the _Grid_.
items.powergrid:wire_cutter.tooltip.behaviour1: Removes a hanging wire, or selected segment of a block wire
items.powergrid:wire_cutter.tooltip.condition2: When Shift R-Clicked on a block wire

blocks.powergrid:circuit_design_table.tooltip.b: Writes the current design into a schematic item
blocks.powergrid:circuit_design_table.tooltip.s: Design and write _Circuit Schematics_. If you want to place components, you must have them in your inventory.
blocks.powergrid:creative_current_source.toolti: An _almost perfect_ current source. Set the output current with the _slider_ or _/powergrid_ command.
blocks.powergrid:creative_voltage_source.toolti: An _almost perfect_ voltage source. Set the output voltage with the _slider_ or _/powergrid_ command.
blocks.powergrid:fe_inverter.tooltip.summary: Converts _Forge Energy_ into _Electricity_ using advanced technology. Use the _Control Pin_ to adjust the output voltage and improve power conversion.
blocks.powergrid:potato_battery.tooltip.summary: An all natural source of green energy
blocks.powergrid:thermometer.tooltip.behaviour1: Measures the temperature of the device it is pointed at
blocks.powergrid:thermometer.tooltip.behaviour2: Measures current and maximum temperature of the device it is placed on over time
blocks.powergrid:thermometer.tooltip.summary: A simple device which measures the temperature of things
